name: Retro Tower Defense
desc:
NEW UPDATE: MAP MASTERY ACHIEVEMENTS, NEW WEEKLY CHALLENGE!

⚔️ RETRO TOWER DEFENSE! Stop the Noob invasion! Summon iconic heroes and relive the golden era of Roblox in the ultimate strategy experience. 🛡️

📈 You can now trade towers with other players! 

Grab your friends and team up to protect the base! Strategize across legendary maps like Crossroads and Doomspire to earn Tix and EXP.

Game Modes: Battle through Casual, Normal, Hard, or test your skills in the infinite Endless mode!

Missions: Complete quests with your squad to unlock powerful Towers.

Skins: Customize your towers with rare skins for c00lkidd, 1x1x1x1, and many more iconic characters!

Events: Collect special event currency to collect limited skins & towers
💻 Device Support: PC, Mac, iOS, Android, Playstation, and Xbox.
🎁 Codes: Use RETRO, FREETIX, or NEW
❓ FAQ: Win rounds to buy new towers. Join forces with friends to earn more rewards!

scripts.title: Dark park Strat grinding (read description)
scripts.features:
Only give you 660+ tix and 800+ exp per match
To use this, you need to execute it once in the lobby, then wait a few seconds until you teleport into a match, and then execute the script again

You need to lvl 25 to make this script work

Required towers
-jeff 2
-venomshank
-pistoller
-noob
-bling bloxxer
-base
You need the required towers listed for it to work, or the script won’t work

No need to trait effect

If the script isn’t working, then idk. I only posted this script for myself, though
